info.title: Service API
info.description: API for handling authentication and service-related operations in the SFA.DAS.FAA.Web project.

Redirects the user to the configured sign-out page.

schema.description: A query string containing encoded sign-in redirect data.

302.description: Redirects to the specified action and controller as needed.

200.description: HTML view of account unavailable page.

404.description: Not found if the environment is PRD.

post.summary: Handles submission of form inputs and sign-in for stub authentication in non-PRD environments.

404.description: Not found if the environment is PRD.
